title: Water Covers Earth, But Lakes And Rivers Hold Just 0.007%
hook: Lakes and rivers hold just 0.007% of Earth's water—not an ocean-sized supply.
closing: Freshwater availability depends on location and access; a watery planet does not guarantee water where people need it.
question: What protects your local freshwater supply?

segments.say: Freshwater makes up 3.5% of Earth's water. Most of the planet's water is salty.
Glaciers and ice caps hold 68.7% of freshwater in this breakdown. Fresh does not automatically mean accessible.
Lakes and rivers contain 0.007% of all Earth's water. Accessible water still requires checking and treatment before drinking.
